full_text: Medical Board of California Decision and Order, Stipulated Settlement and Disciplinary Order in the Matter of the Accusation Against Hozair M. Syed, M.D., Certificate No. A 111058, Case No. 09-2010-211439. Effective March 21, 2014, Dr. Syed's certificate is revoked, stayed, and placed on probation for seven (7) years. Disciplinary terms include a 30-day actual suspension, community service (200 hours of free medical services), professional boundaries program, psychiatric evaluation, psychotherapy, and solo practice prohibition. Accusation filed by Kamala D. Harris, Attorney General of California, alleging sexual abuse, misconduct, and unprofessional relations with a patient.
